payload.summary: IMPL_REVIEW round 9 for derive-descriptors-from-contracts. Outcome: CONVERGED. Confirming round for Phase 6 (commit 081663b2), which remediated round 8's 2 blocking + 1 high + 3 medium + 5 low findings. Multi-vendor review (codex gpt-5.5, grok grok-4.5, antigravity gemini-3.6-flash-medium; pi failed with invalid JSON - quorum 3/4; claude excluded as author). 23 raw findings: ZERO blocking, ZERO critical, ZERO high. Twenty are disposition:accept confirmations, three are nits. All eleven round-8 findings independently confirmed fixed by direct execution, both here and by at least two vendors each. Every gate this change adds was shown to go red on a broken tree and green when restored, with mutated files restored byte-for-byte. Four non-blocking items recorded (N1-N4). Full detail in reviews/round-9/synthesis.md.

decisions.title: Verdict converged - no blocking findings from three independent vendors nor from this review
decisions.rationale: Round 9 existed because Phase 6's fixes were only the author's claim. All eleven round-8 findings are now confirmed fixed by execution rather than assertion, by at least two independent parties each. The new Phase-6 code (error_excludes, the two new fixtures, the $ref sibling refusal, the declared_interface_count cross-check) was reviewed as new code and no vendor raised a critical or high finding against it.

decisions.title: N1 raised on own verification: coverage attribution credits a flag for being passed, not asserted
decisions.rationale: Evaluator._extract_interfaces (evaluator.py:614-623) credits a coverage unit for any declared flag token appearing in a step's args, with no link to whether an assertion depends on it. H1 was fixed at the scenario level but the laundering mechanism is unchanged. Verified two of the ten credited units still ride it: removing --output-dir from the report-format scenario leaves all three assertions intact (the report is simply written to cwd and error_contains still substring-matches), and removing --fail-threshold yields the identical zero-scenario observable. Honest figure is 8 of 17. Non-blocking because no gate outcome changes - 47% still clears the --min-coverage 1 floor - and each still pins that argparse accepts the flag.

decisions.title: N2 (codex) kept as a nit rather than escalated to blocking like round-8 B2
decisions.rationale: work-packages.yaml still instructs the superseded CONTRACT_VERSION 2->3 bump. B2 was blocking because the DELTA SPEC archives into openspec/specs/ as a durable requirement; work-packages.yaml archives as a historical record of the plan, not as a requirement anything is checked against. Same stale-plan family, materially lower blast radius.

decisions.title: Pi's invalid-JSON failure treated as known dispatcher fragility, not a review gap
decisions.rationale: Round 8 lost antigravity the same way and round 9 lost pi. Quorum was still 3, and the three that returned converge on every conclusion. The underlying defect - a malformed vendor response is discarded rather than re-dispatched - has been unfiled since round 7 and is worth filing separately.

next_steps: Orchestrator: apply-outcome --phase IMPL_REVIEW --outcome converged --handoff-id impl-review-9, then advance to VALIDATE (val_review_enabled=false), then SUBMIT_PR - no PR exists yet

N1 (medium, optional before merge): give cli:--output-dir and cli:--fail-threshold a discriminating assertion, or move both into coverage-exclusions.yaml with an honest reason. --output-dir has an obvious one: assert the report path under a non-default directory
N2 (nit): update work-packages.yaml:446-559 to drop the CONTRACT_VERSION 2->3 language and fix the D11 verification command to use --report/--exclusions flags instead of a positional argument
N3 (nit): wrap the declared_interface_count coercion at check_coverage_completeness.py:67 in a _fail(...) message consistent with the L3 guards
N4 (fyi): use an explicit change target in reproducible openspec validate commands; bare `openspec validate --strict` selects nothing non-interactively
REBASE BEFORE MERGE - the branch is ~23 commits behind main, so green here is not green on the merge result
File the review-dispatcher fragility separately: a vendor returning malformed JSON is discarded rather than re-dispatched (cost two vendors across rounds 8 and 9)
STOP AT MERGE for human approval
